findings.current: He’d seen his master holding a bloodied sword beside his Junior Brother’s severed head.
findings.defect: The draft places the severed head beside Cheongheoja; the source says he was holding both the head and the bloody sword.
findings.rationale: The master’s possession of the head is part of the apparent proof of Hak Eui’s death.
findings.replacement: He’d seen his master holding his Junior Brother’s severed head and a sword dripping with blood.
findings.source: 잘려 나간 사제의 목과 피가 흐르는 검을 들고 있던 스승의 모습을 볼 수 있었다.

findings.defect: Cheongheoja asks who is running out of time, not whom Hak Su is addressing.
findings.rationale: The question turns Hak Su’s warning back on him; Cheongheoja repeats it explicitly in his next line.

findings.current: A dead man had come back to life.
findings.defect: The draft asserts a resurrection. The source describes the appearance of someone believed to be dead.
findings.rationale: The subsequent dialogue reveals that Hak Eui’s death was staged.
findings.replacement: The man they had believed dead stood before them.
findings.source: 이미 돌아올 수 없는 강을 건넜다고 알려진 망자(亡者)가, 모두의 앞에 모습을 드러냈으니.

findings.current: He had taken a boy he’d happened to meet wandering near Qinghai Lake—and who had concealed his true purpose—as a sign of fate.
findings.defect: Hak Su staged the encounter to look accidental; the draft instead calls it a chance meeting and only says he hid his purpose.
findings.rationale: 우연을 가장한 specifies the deception’s mechanism: the apparent coincidence was deliberate.
findings.replacement: He had accepted his meeting with a boy wandering near Qinghai Lake as fate, never knowing the boy had made it look like chance.
findings.source: 우연을 가장한 채 청해호 인근을 떠돌던 어느 소년과의 만남을 운명으로 받아들였으니까.

findings.current: The Elders known as the Kunlun Ten Guests, destined to follow in the Kunlun Five Immortals’ footsteps and considered essential pillars of the Kunlun Sect,
findings.defect: The draft makes the Ten Guests current Elders; the source describes them as future Elders expected to succeed the Five Immortals.
findings.rationale: 향후 marks their elder status as prospective.
findings.replacement: The Kunlun Ten Guests, regarded as future Elders who would succeed the Kunlun Five Immortals and as indispensable pillars of the Kunlun Sect,
findings.source: 곤륜십객(崑崙十客)이라 불리며, 향후 곤륜오선의 뒤를 이을 장로들이자 작금의 곤륜파에서 빼놓을 수 없는 중추로 여겨지는 그들은

findings.current: Hak Eui’s eyes widened at the unbelievable sight beyond Cheongheoja’s shoulder, which now blocked his view.
findings.defect: Cheongheoja blocks Hak Eui’s path, not his view; Hak Eui sees the scene over his shoulder.
findings.rationale: 앞을 가로막은 describes Cheongheoja intercepting Hak Eui’s advance.
findings.replacement: Cheongheoja had stepped into his path. Over his master’s shoulder, Hak Eui caught sight of something unbelievable, and his eyes widened.
findings.source: 어느덧 앞을 가로막은 청허자의 어깨너머로 보이는 믿을 수 없는 광경에, 학의는 눈을 부릅떴다.

findings.defect: The draft drops 호, which makes the name a numbered designation rather than simply the word “Six.”
findings.rationale: 육호 identifies him by an assigned number.

summary: The draft changes the staged meeting, the decoy’s physical evidence, and several details of the reveal.
